metadata.title: Author Archive
metadata.subtitle: A curated collection of interviews, commentaries, afterwords, magazine features, and other historical material from Hitoma Iruma.

articles.title: A Sudden Corner Where I Talk About What I've Been Thinking Regarding My More Recent Characters
articles.summary: Hitoma Iruma reflects on the characters of Adachi to Shimamura -- particularly Shimamura Hōgetsu and Adachi Sakura -- discussing their evolution, their role as protagonists, and the author's personal connection to them after more than a decade of writing.

articles.title: DIARY FROM JUNE 2021
articles.summary: Hitoma Iruma discusses the origin of the character names in Adachi to Shimamura, revealing the inspirations behind Shimamura Hōgetsu, Adachi Sakura, Hino Akira, Nagafuji Taeko, and others.

articles.title: Iruma Hitoma's Q&A — Round 1
articles.summary: The first installment of Iruma Hitoma's reader Q&A column on his now-defunct official site, touching on his approach to writing, favorite games and books, thoughts on becoming a novelist, and status updates on several of his works.

articles.title: Iruma Hitoma's Q&A — Round 2
articles.summary: The second installment of Iruma Hitoma's reader Q&A column, covering the site's first-anniversary popularity poll, character origins and cover-art conventions in Tokage no Ou, advice on writing appealing characters, and his pre-debut history of contest submissions.

articles.title: Iruma Hitoma's Q&A — Round 3
articles.summary: The third installment of Iruma Hitoma's reader Q&A column, touching on plans (or lack thereof) for anime adaptations, his packed slate of concurrent series, favorite mecha anime, a typo correction in Yuiitsu no Negai, and his ever-growing 'Iruma Army' of aspiring novelists.

articles.title: Iruma Hitoma's Q&A — Round 4
articles.summary: The fourth installment of Iruma Hitoma's reader Q&A column, covering the still-unresolved fate of Akkyun's daughter, a wish list of Usotsuki Mii-kun cameos, a proposal to republish a long-out-of-print promotional booklet, and a fresh wave of recruits to the 'Iruma Legion.'

articles.title: Iruma Hitoma's Q&A — Round 5
articles.summary: The fifth installment of Iruma Hitoma's reader Q&A column, ranging across The Isolated's countdown chapter titles, the renamed Hitomi no Sagashimono, a deep dive into favorite JoJo's Bizarre Adventure moments, and the writing habits and daily routines that keep Iruma at his desk.

articles.title: Iruma Hitoma's Q&A — Round 6
articles.summary: The sixth installment of Iruma Hitoma's reader Q&A column, featuring a rapid-fire decoding of 'Super Iruma War' crossover cameos, the naming of Akkyun and Ma-chan's twin daughters, the three-second origin of The Naked Idiot Comes Running's title, and yet more hopeful recruits to the 'Iruma Legion.'

articles.title: Iruma Hitoma's Q&A — Round 7
articles.summary: The seventh installment of Iruma Hitoma's reader Q&A column, covering a fan-submitted 'Ikemen Point' ranking of the cast, the abandoned plan to merge two characters from separate series, a Dengeki Illustration Award path to becoming his illustrator, and a not-so-subtle appearance by his own editor in the question queue.
